defects.title: The LPSolver input is ignored
defects.observed: (R2025a, gurobi) identical output to the call without LPSolver; lines 106-109 set a default nothing reads (changeCobraSolver at line 110 commented out by feature 015)
defects.expected: the documented LP solver is used

notes: Reproductions (MATLAB R2025a, gurobi, 2026-11-25), with m = createModel({'EX_a';'IEM1';'Whole_body_objective_rxn';'DM_a'}, {'';'';'';''}, {' -> a[c]';'a[c] -> b[c]';'b[c] -> ';'a[c] -> '}, 'lowerBoundList', [0 0 0 0], 'upperBoundList', [10 1000 1000 0], 'printLevel', 0); changeCobraSolver('gurobi','LP',0); BM = {'DM_a','Increased (blood)'}; S = checkIEM_WBM(m, {'IEM1'}, BM, 0.75) gives IEM obj 10/0, WB obj Disease 0 (origStat 'OPTIMAL'), Healthy:DM_a 2.5, Disease:DM_a 10 (as predicted by hand). (1) S = checkIEM_WBM(m, {'IEM1'}, BM, 0.75, 0, 1, 1); S{6,4} = '10' (expected '0'), S{5,4} = '0'. (2) m5 = createModel with a fifth reaction 'DM_ab' (' -> a[c]', lb 0, ub 0); checkIEM_WBM(m5, {'IEM1'}, BM, 0.75) gives 100000/100000 instead of 2.5/10. (3) fractionKO 0.5 ignored with fixIEMlb 0; with fixIEMlb 1 the disease solve is infeasible. (4) reverseDirObj 1 gives the same output as 0. (5) LPSolver 'noSuchSolver' gives the same output. Reach for the lead: the only src caller runIEM_HH (script) calls checkIEM_WBM(model, IEMRxns, BiomarkerRxns, minRxnsFluxHealthy) with 4 inputs, so defects 1, 3, 4, 5 are confined to call forms it does not use (minBiomarker 1, fractionKO ~= 1, reverseDirObj 1, LPSolver given); defect 2 depends on the model data (a reaction whose identifier starts with a biomarker identifier; whole-body biomarkers end in ']' which makes it unlikely but not excluded). If the lead lowers defects 3-5 and treats 1 and 2 as call-form/data confined, a full test is straightforward with the model m (coverage notes: lines 225, 247-253, 263-264, 293-299, 309-310 are reachable only on solver failure since only the objective changes between feasible solves; lines 175-176 are behind 'if 0'). Default inputs reach no optimizeWBModel defect: it is always called with one input (solveWBMmethod 'LP', minNorm 0). The model passed must have csense, b and Whole_body_objective_rxn (lines 124-125, 201); the dummy column added at line 120 has no rxns entry, which optimizeCbModel accepts. Coverage: 161 executable lines, all exempt by the quarantine. extra_edges: changeObjective is called on every call that reaches line 201.
confirmed_by: lead, 2026-11-25: minBiomarker 1 maximises; biomarker bound set by prefix match (lines 238, 288); fractionKO, reverseDirObj, LPSolver ignored (writer reproduced all five); default reach (the prefix match depends on data)

The time per organ is printed in exponential notation

notes: Reproductions (MATLAB R2025a, gurobi, 2026-11-25). Toy model: rxns = {'EX_a';'Heart_biomass_maintenance';'Liver_biomass_maintenance';'Whole_body_objective_rxn';'EX_b';'Brain_x';'EX_c'}; model = createModel(rxns, rxns, {' -> a[c]';'a[c] -> Heart_biomass_maintenance_dummy_objective[c]';'a[c] -> Liver_biomass_maintenance_dummy_objective[c]';'Heart_biomass_maintenance_dummy_objective[c] + Liver_biomass_maintenance_dummy_objective[c] -> ';' -> b[c]';'b[c] -> c[c]';'c[c] -> '}, 'lowerBoundList', [0 0 0 0 0 0 1], 'upperBoundList', [10 1000 1000 1000 1000 1000 1000], 'printLevel', 0); model.mets = regexprep(model.mets, '\[c\]$', ''); model.sex = 'male'. organEssentiality(model, 'gurobi') gives Heart '10', Liver '10', Brain NaN/'INFEASIBLE', every other organ '5' (male and female), as predicted by hand: a full test would be easy if the lead lowers the two blocking defects. (1) fprinf: put a folder first on the path holding optimizeWBModel.m = function solution = optimizeWBModel(model, param); solution = struct('f', NaN, 'v', [], 'stat', -1, 'origStat', 'TIME_LIMIT'); end, then organEssentiality(model, 'gurobi') -> error at line 87; exist('fprinf') = 0. With gurobi an infeasible organ gives stat 0 (NaN row, no error); stat 2 is impossible (objective bounded to 1000 at line 42), so only a time limit or numerical failure reaches line 87 - the lead may judge this lower than 'error'. (2) organEssentiality(model, 'ILOGcomplex') errors at line 38. The default LPSolver 'tomlab_cplex' cannot run here (TOMLAB licence error from changeCobraSolver; environment, not a defect). Line 38 changes the global LP solver as documented intent (a test must restore CobraSolverState). No src caller (grep finds none). Coverage: the coverage plugin reports 0 executable lines for this file (as for some other PSCM files), so lines/missed are 0/[]; every line is exempt by the quarantine anyway. OrganLists and getOrganWeightFraction run as scripts at lines 50-51 (both EXCLUDED as scripts). extra_edges: changeCobraSolver, changeRxnBounds and changeObjective are called on every call.
confirmed_by: lead, 2026-11-25: misspelt fprinf at line 87 crashes when a solve returns stat -1 or 2; documented LPSolver 'ILOGcomplex' errors at line 38 (writer reproduced); no src caller
